plan.title: Hallmark GSEA: psoriasis treated vs control
plan.analytical_narrative: The DESeq2 results table for the treated (psoriasis lesional skin) vs control contrast (12,000 genes, 6 vs 6 unpaired human samples, single batch) is already delivered, so no new DE test is fitted. The question — which hallmark pathways change — is answered by preranked GSEA (fgsea) of the full 12,000-gene ranked list, ranked by the DESeq2 Wald statistic (the side chosen on the disputed ranking-metric rule R-0108), against the human MSigDB Hallmark gene sets (release 2026.1, symbol-keyed) with Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment and a 15–500 size window. Per the procedure, a second pass on Reactome (human-filtered, current store release) and WikiPathways (human, 2026.07.10) resolves hallmark hits into specific pathways. A sample-structure QC on the delivered counts precedes the enrichment as inherited context: sample_01 sits ~4x below the median library size and is kept (keep_inspect_report policy), so its influence on the delivered DE is carried into the interpretation rather than re-run. The report states each collection with its version, the rank metric, the universe, the size window, leading-edge genes per significant set, and a reproducibility record (seed, package versions, collection versions), and frames the pathway sets as method-dependent hypotheses.

flags.message: If one sample has a library size several times below the median of the study, do not delete it in silence. Keep it through the sample structure QC, look at it on the PCA and on the sample distance heatmap, report its library size and its detected genes beside the others, and remove it only with a stated reason. The count models down-weight a low-depth sample through its size factor, thus removal is a judgment, not a default.

If fewer than about 50 genes pass the significance threshold, do not run an over-representation test on that list. A hypergeometric test of a short list finds no category, and a change of the threshold changes the list and the result. Run the ranked method on the full list of tested genes instead, because it finds a set of genes with a small but coordinated change that no single gene shows. State the size of the significant list in the report.
